selection_decisions: Selected live article maintenance and review queue, collaborative navigation research and reviewed bilingual drafts.
Kept active64 articles, not archived91; no causality inferred from usability test.
Omitted unapproved AI proposal, unrelated recipe notebook and older concurrent note-taking role as less relevant.
Moderated test stated without claiming candidate personally moderated it.

uncertainty_handling.handling: Navigation described only as research, drafts and observed test; no launch date or launched-redesign claim.
uncertainty_handling.question: Which dated record confirms whether and when the navigation changes launched?
